CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_1: AI IS LITERAL AND STUPID — Describe EVERYTHING as if explaining to someone who has never seen anything before
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_2: REDUNDANCY IS POWER — Say the same critical thing 3 different ways: technical term + plain description + emotional effect
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_3: INVISIBLE DETAILS MATTER — Describe what you DON'T consciously notice but your brain processes: air quality, reflected colors on skin, micro-shadows in fabric folds, dust in light beams
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_4: ANTI-FAILURE ENGINEERING — For every known AI weakness (hands, eyes, proportions, fabric, symmetry), include explicit corrective instructions
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_5: THE PRESET FILLS THE GAPS — When analysis is incomplete, the matched Pinterest preset provides default values that maintain quality
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_6: ONE JSON RULES THEM ALL — All data interconnected in one structure, because AI generators produce dramatically better results when they receive ALL visual data as structured interconnected data rather than isolated text
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_7: EVERY PIXEL HAS PURPOSE — There is no random element. Every color, every shadow, every wrinkle in fabric serves the story
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_8: OVER-DESCRIBE, NEVER UNDER-DESCRIBE — A 400-word prompt that's too detailed will ALWAYS beat a 50-word prompt that's too vague
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_9: REAL GEAR, REAL FILM, REAL REFERENCES — Use actual camera bodies, actual lenses, actual film stocks, actual cinematographers, actual films. AI responds to specificity
CATASTROPHIC_PHILOSOPHY.principle_10: THE NEGATIVE PROMPT IS HALF THE BATTLE — Telling AI what NOT to do is as important as telling it what to do

INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_01: RECEIVE — User uploads reference image from Pinterest/Instagram/Behance OR describes a scene in any language
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_02: IDENTIFY AESTHETIC — Match to closest Pinterest aesthetic preset(s) from the 120+ preset library
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_03: PRESET BLEND — Determine primary preset (60-70%), secondary preset (20-30%), accent preset (10%)
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_04: DEEP ANALYSIS — Run the image through ALL 60+ analysis layers simultaneously
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_05: CROSS-REFERENCE — Compare analysis results with preset defaults. Where analysis provides detail → use analysis. Where analysis is incomplete → use preset defaults
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_06: AI FAILURE PREVENTION — Inject anti-failure safeguards for hands, eyes, skin, fabric, proportions, depth
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_07: EMOTIONAL CALIBRATION — Ensure every technical choice serves the emotional story of the image
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_08: PROMPT COMPILATION — Synthesize all 60+ layers into one flowing master prompt
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_10: JSON ASSEMBLY — Pack everything into one complete, valid, parseable JSON
INPUT_PROCESSING_ENGINE.step_11: SELF-CHECK — Verify all mandatory fields, validate JSON, check word counts, confirm quality

layer_01_subject_identity.ai_failure_prevention: Always specify 'anatomically correct human proportions' and 'realistic human body'

layer_02_face_complete.analyze: Every facial feature in surgical detail

output_fields.eyebrows: shape, thickness, arch, color, grooming, distance apart, symmetry

eyes.color: specific shade with detail (not just 'brown' but 'warm chestnut brown with honey-gold flecks near the pupil')
eyes.iris_detail: texture, pattern, ring around iris, color variation
eyes.pupil: size relative to iris (dilated=dark setting, constricted=bright setting)
eyes.catchlights: position (10 o'clock/2 o'clock), shape (window/softbox/circular), brightness, number of catchlights
eyes.eyelids: position, crease visibility, hooded or not
eyes.eyelashes: length, curl, thickness, natural or mascara enhanced

output_fields.nose: bridge width, tip shape, nostril size, profile shape, highlight on bridge

layer_02_face_complete.ai_failure_prevention: ALWAYS include: 'both eyes symmetrically aligned and same size, natural eye spacing, realistic iris texture with visible catchlight reflection in each eye, anatomically correct facial proportions'

layer_03_expression_ultra.analyze: Micro-expression analysis — the difference between a good image and a masterpiece

eye_gaze.focus: sharp focused on something specific / soft unfocused distant / looking through something

mouth_expression.if_smile: degree (barely there/slight/half/full/laughing), genuine (Duchenne with eye crinkle) or posed (mouth only), symmetry (symmetrical/asymmetrical smirk), teeth showing (none/top row/full/gap)

output_fields.the_micro_detail: THE ONE tiny asymmetric detail that makes it look REAL — slightly higher left eyebrow, one corner of mouth 1mm higher, slight nostril flare, barely visible forehead crease. This is what separates AI-looking from REAL-looking
output_fields.expression_reads_as: One sentence that captures what a viewer would think/feel looking at this face

layer_03_expression_ultra.ai_failure_prevention: Always describe expression from multiple angles — muscle position + emotional name + what viewer perceives. Example: 'subtle Mona Lisa smile with barely upturned mouth corners and warm knowing eyes, creating an expression of quiet amusement mixed with gentle melancholy'

layer_04_body_pose_surgical.analyze: Complete body positioning with anatomical precision

output_fields.spine_alignment: straight vertical/slightly curved forward/arched back/C-curve slouch/S-curve contrapposto/twisted rotation

head.turn: direction and degree (e.g., turned 30° left toward camera)

left_hand.position: at side/on hip/touching face/in pocket/holding object/on surface/behind back/in hair/gesturing
left_hand.fingers: ALL FIVE described — relaxed natural spread/together/specific positions
left_hand.what_touching: if touching something, what and how

output_fields.feet: position, visible or not, angle, weight distribution
output_fields.implied_motion: static frozen/about to move/caught mid-motion/coming to rest/dynamic action
output_fields.contrapposto: if weight shift creates classical contrapposto S-curve

layer_04_body_pose_surgical.ai_failure_prevention: MANDATORY in every prompt: 'anatomically correct human body with natural proportions, realistic joint articulation, natural weight distribution, properly connected limbs'

layer_05_hands_critical.analyze: HANDS ARE THE #1 AI FAILURE — treat with maximum detail

left_hand_complete.nails: length, shape, polish color or natural
left_hand_complete.holding_object: if yes, what and how the grip works mechanically

output_fields.hand_interaction: if hands touch each other or interact, describe exactly how

layer_05_hands_critical.ai_failure_prevention: ALWAYS ALWAYS ALWAYS include: 'anatomically correct human hands with EXACTLY five fingers per hand (thumb + four fingers), natural finger length proportions where middle finger is longest, proper finger joint bending, realistic fingernail size and position, natural hand scale relative to face (hand = approximately face-length from chin to forehead)'

output_fields.color: primary + secondary tones + root vs ends + highlight colors (be SPECIFIC: not 'blonde' but 'warm honey blonde with darker ash roots and sun-lightened ends')
output_fields.volume: flat/normal/voluminous/very full — where the volume concentrates
output_fields.style: specific style name and description (messy beach waves, sleek blowout, french braid, textured crop, etc.)
output_fields.movement: static/gentle movement/wind blown (direction)/in motion/underwater floating/wet clinging

light_interaction.shine_pattern: where highlights appear on hair curves
light_interaction.backlit_effect: rim light creating golden/bright halo on edges
light_interaction.translucency: light passing through thin hair sections showing warm glow
light_interaction.color_shift: how hair color changes from shadow to highlight

output_fields.individual_strands: flyaway strands visible, baby hairs at hairline and temples catching light, loose strands across face
output_fields.hair_accessories: clips, pins, ribbons, headband, hat, crown, flowers — with material and color

layer_06_hair_complete.ai_failure_prevention: Include: 'natural realistic hair with individual strands visible, not helmet-like or plastic, natural volume variation, gravity-appropriate hair fall, realistic hair-light interaction with subtle highlights on wave peaks'

layer_07_skin_hyper_detail.analyze: Skin realism is the difference between CG-looking and photograph-looking

texture.pores: not visible/subtly visible/clearly visible/prominent — where most visible (nose, cheeks, forehead)
texture.smoothness: baby smooth/smooth with texture/normal visible texture/rough/weathered

imperfections_that_add_realism.freckles: presence, density, location (nose bridge, cheeks, shoulders, arms), color (light golden/medium brown/dark)
imperfections_that_add_realism.redness_areas: nose tip slightly pinker/cheeks flushed/no redness
imperfections_that_add_realism.wrinkles_lines: location, depth (smile lines, forehead lines, crow's feet, neck lines, lip lines)

light_interaction.subsurface_scattering: warm red-orange glow visible through thin skin areas — ear edges, fingertips, nose tip backlit, between fingers when backlit
light_interaction.specular_highlights: where skin catches direct light reflection — forehead, nose bridge, upper cheekbones, chin, shoulders — size and intensity of these highlights
light_interaction.oily_sheen_areas: T-zone slight reflectivity or completely matte
light_interaction.shadow_color_on_skin: shadows on skin are never pure grey — they shift warm (reddish) or cool (bluish) depending on lighting

color_variation_map.neck: usually slightly different tone from face
color_variation_map.ears: often redder, show more subsurface scattering
color_variation_map.chest_if_visible: may show sun exposure difference, often slightly more textured

output_fields.body_hair_micro: peach fuzz on face catching side light, arm hair, any visible body hair with light interaction

layer_07_skin_hyper_detail.ai_failure_prevention: CRITICAL: 'realistic human skin with visible pores and natural skin texture, NOT plastic or porcelain or airbrushed or wax-figure, natural subsurface scattering creating warm glow in thin skin areas, natural skin color variation between different body areas, no uncanny valley smoothness'

layer_08_eyes_precision.analyze: Eyes are the soul of the image — get them wrong and everything fails

output_fields.color_detailed: outer iris ring color, main iris color, inner iris ring near pupil, any heterochromia or color pattern
output_fields.iris_texture: radial fibers visible, rings, crypts, furrows — these add realism
output_fields.pupil: size (small in bright light, large in dark), perfectly round, centered in iris
output_fields.sclera: white portion — clean white with very subtle blue or yellowish tint, maybe tiny red vessels at corners for realism

catchlight.position: clock position (standard portrait: 10 o'clock and 2 o'clock)
catchlight.shape: reflects the actual light source shape — rectangular window, round softbox, square studio light, irregular natural
catchlight.number: how many catchlights per eye (1-2 is natural, more looks unnatural)

output_fields.eyelid_position: how much of iris is covered by upper lid, lower lid position
output_fields.moisture: subtle moisture layer makes eyes look alive — specify 'slight moisture reflection on lower lid waterline'
output_fields.gaze_precision: exactly where the eyes are pointed — this affects the entire image feeling. Direct at camera lens = connection. Slightly off = natural candid. Away = story

layer_08_eyes_precision.ai_failure_prevention: MANDATORY: 'both eyes perfectly symmetrically aligned on the same horizontal plane, identical size, natural eye spacing approximately one eye-width apart, each eye has a small bright catchlight reflection at consistent position, realistic iris texture with radial fiber pattern, sharp clear eyes with slight natural moisture, no crossed eyes, no wall-eye, no dead lifeless eyes'

layer_09_primary_garment.analyze: Main clothing piece in fabric-scientist detail

output_fields.garment_type: SPECIFIC name (not 'top' but 'relaxed-fit crewneck cable-knit pullover sweater')

fabric.weight: sheer see-through/lightweight flowing/medium standard/heavy structured/very heavy stiff
fabric.weave_knit_pattern: plain weave/twill/satin weave/jersey knit/cable knit/rib knit/lace pattern/herringbone/houndstooth

color.name: specific descriptive name
color.how_appears_in_this_light: how the lighting affects the perceived color (warmer/cooler/darker/lighter than actual)

fit.how_on_body: where it's tight, where it's loose, where it gathers, where it pulls

output_fields.construction_details: seams visible, stitching, buttons (material, color, size), zippers (where, metal type), pockets, collar type and construction, sleeve type and length, hem treatment, lining visible, tags, labels

fabric_behavior.wrinkles: where wrinkles naturally occur based on body position and fabric type — elbow bends, waist gathers, behind knees, collar area. Describe each wrinkle zone
fabric_behavior.gravity_response: how gravity pulls the fabric — where it sags, where tension creates smooth areas, where it pools
fabric_behavior.movement_response: if in motion, how fabric reacts — fluttering, lagging behind, clinging, swinging
fabric_behavior.body_interaction: where fabric presses against body vs where it hangs free, where body shape is visible through fabric vs where fabric creates its own shape
fabric_behavior.fold_characteristics: sharp creases or soft rounded folds — determined by fabric stiffness

output_fields.condition: brand new/worn-in comfortable/vintage aged/slightly distressed/heavily distressed/damaged/dirty/stained/faded
output_fields.light_on_fabric: how light creates highlights on fold peaks and shadows in fold valleys, how the fabric's finish affects light reflection, any sheen or light absorption

layer_09_primary_garment.ai_failure_prevention: 'realistic fabric with natural gravity-appropriate draping and wrinkle patterns, fabric responds to body shape and position naturally, wrinkles at joint bends and gathered areas, NOT painted-on or shrink-wrapped onto body, visible fabric texture and thread pattern at close distances'

layer_10_secondary_garments.analyze: Every additional clothing layer with same detail as layer 09
layer_10_secondary_garments.note: Apply identical analysis structure to each: jacket, coat, vest, cardigan, undershirt, pants/skirt, socks, belt, scarf, etc. Each gets full fabric analysis

output_fields.type: specific shoe type (Chelsea boot, Nike Air Force 1, pointed-toe stiletto pump, leather Oxford, canvas sneaker, gladiator sandal, etc.)
output_fields.sole_details: if visible — type, color, wear pattern
output_fields.how_worn: laced tight/loose/untied/slip-on/buckled — and how feet sit in them
output_fields.heel: flat/low/mid/high/stiletto/block/platform — exact height estimate if visible

jewelry.light_reflection: how metal catches and reflects light — sharp specular highlights on polished gold, muted glow on brushed silver, sparkle on gemstones
jewelry.position_on_body: exactly where it sits, how it hangs or rests

output_fields.eyewear: if present — frame shape, frame material and color, lens type (clear/tinted/mirror/gradient/prescription), how worn (normally/pushed up on head/low on nose), reflection content in lenses
output_fields.headwear: type, material, color, how worn, position on head
output_fields.belts: material, width, buckle type and metal
output_fields.watches: brand/style, face size, strap material, time shown if visible
output_fields.other: any other accessory with full detail

layer_13_styling_dna.analyze: The overall style story and aesthetic category

output_fields.designer_brand_references: which brands this styling evokes (even if not specifically those brands)
output_fields.overall_styling_intention: what the outfit communicates about the character — their personality, status, mood, lifestyle
output_fields.color_coordination: how all clothing and accessory colors work together and relate to the scene's overall color palette

output_fields.overall_level: no makeup/natural 'no-makeup makeup'/subtle everyday/polished/editorial dramatic/avant-garde artistic/character/theatrical
output_fields.base: visible foundation or natural skin showing through, finish (matte/natural/dewy/satin), coverage (sheer/light/medium/full), skin-matching or slightly different
output_fields.concealer: visible (under eye brightening, blemish covering) or not apparent
output_fields.powder: set matte or not powdered (dewy), visible or not
output_fields.blush: color (peach/pink/mauve/berry/coral/brown), placement (apples/draping/sun-stripe/nose tip), intensity (barely there/natural flush/obvious/editorial strong)
output_fields.contour_highlight: sculpted contour visible or not, highlight placement (cheekbone/nose bridge/cupid's bow/brow bone/inner corner), highlight finish (subtle/glass/blinding)
output_fields.eyebrows: shape (natural/arched/straight/bushy/thin), fill method (pencil/powder/laminated/natural unfilled), color match to hair or different
output_fields.eyeshadow: colors used, placement (lid/crease/outer corner/inner corner/under eye), finish (matte/shimmer/metallic/glitter), blending quality, shape (round/elongated/cat eye)
output_fields.eyeliner: type (pencil/gel/liquid/kohl/none), style (thin line/winged cat eye/puppy eye/smudged/graphic/tightline), color
output_fields.lashes: natural/mascara (lengthening/volumizing/curled)/false lashes (strip/individual/dramatic/natural-looking), lash length and curl
output_fields.lips: color (nude/MLBB/pink/red/berry/brown/dark/clear gloss), finish (matte/satin/glossy/velvet), product type (lipstick/gloss/stain/liner), overlined or natural line, symmetry
output_fields.specialty: any special makeup — beauty mark/graphic liner/glitter/rhinestones/face jewels/colored mascara/editorial elements

output_fields.shot_size: EWS (extreme wide, tiny figure in vast space) / WS (wide, full environment with figure) / FS (full shot, entire body) / MWS (cowboy/American shot, knees up) / MS (medium, waist up) / MCU (medium close-up, chest up) / CU (close-up, face fills frame) / ECU (extreme close-up, single feature — one eye, lips, hand) / Macro (extreme detail)
output_fields.subject_coverage: percentage of frame the subject occupies
output_fields.leadroom_lookroom: space in front of where subject looks (generous=comfortable, tight=tension)
output_fields.body_cutoff: where the frame cuts the body (never at joints — not at knees, elbows, ankles, wrists)

output_fields.vertical: worm's eye (ground up, extreme power) / low angle (below eye level, empowering) / eye level (neutral, relatable) / slightly above eye level (flattering portraits) / high angle (looking down, vulnerability) / bird's eye (directly above, pattern) — with degree estimate
output_fields.horizontal: straight-on frontal / slight 3-quarter (15-20°) / 3-quarter (30-45°, most common portrait angle) / near profile (60-75°) / full profile (90°) / 3-quarter back (100-135°) / behind (180°) / over-the-shoulder (OTS from behind someone)
output_fields.tilt: level (horizon straight) / Dutch angle left (unease) / Dutch angle right (unease) — with degree
output_fields.psychological_effect: what this specific angle combination makes the viewer feel about the subject (power, intimacy, vulnerability, disconnection, confrontation, voyeurism, etc.)

layer_17_lens_science.analyze: Exact lens characteristics and their visual effects

focal_length.category: ultra-wide (14-20mm) / wide (24-28mm) / moderate wide (35mm) / standard (40-50mm) / short telephoto (65-85mm) / medium telephoto (100-135mm) / long telephoto (200mm+)
focal_length.visual_effect: distortion level, compression, spatial relationship between subject and background, perspective

output_fields.lens_type: spherical / anamorphic (2x squeeze, oval bokeh, horizontal flares) / vintage (softer, aberrations, character) / modern (clinical, sharp) / macro / tilt-shift / Petzval (swirly bokeh) / specialty
output_fields.specific_lens_emulation: real lens name — e.g., 'Canon 85mm f/1.2L II' or 'Cooke S4/i 50mm' or 'Helios 44-2 58mm (swirly bokeh)' or 'Leica Summilux 50mm f/1.4' or 'Panavision Anamorphic C-series'
output_fields.lens_character: clinical Zeiss sharpness / warm Cooke 'Cooke Look' / Leica micro-contrast 'pop' / vintage soft glow / anamorphic dreaminess / perfect modern optics

layer_18_depth_of_field_complete.analyze: What's sharp and what's blurred — in forensic detail

output_fields.dof_type: ultra-shallow (millimeters, like f/1.2 at close range) / shallow (subject sharp, background fully blurred) / moderate (subject and some environment sharp) / deep (most things sharp) / infinite (everything sharp, landscape)
output_fields.focus_point: EXACTLY what is the sharpest point in the image (usually the nearest eye in portraits)
output_fields.sharp_zone: from where to where is acceptably sharp

foreground_blur.blur_intensity: slightly soft / moderately blurred / heavily blurred / completely abstract

background_blur.elements: what is visible in background even though blurred — shapes, colors, lights
background_blur.blur_intensity: slightly soft / moderately blurred / heavily blurred / completely abstract

bokeh_details.shape: perfect circles (fast modern lens wide open) / hexagonal (stopped down with straight blades) / octagonal / cat-eye (at frame edges with some lenses) / oval (anamorphic) / swirly (Petzval/Helios)
bokeh_details.quality: smooth creamy (good lens) / busy nervous (lesser lens) / ringed (mirror lens) / textured
bokeh_details.size: small dots / medium circles / large prominent orbs
bokeh_details.color: what colors the bokeh balls are — usually from background lights, signs, foliage
bokeh_details.light_source_in_bokeh: what real-world light sources are creating the bokeh — string lights, car headlights, sun through leaves, neon signs, city lights, candles

output_fields.focus_transition: how quickly sharp becomes blurry — gradual smooth transition / relatively quick falloff / very abrupt
output_fields.tilt_shift_effect: if selective focus plane is tilted — miniature effect or selective strip of focus

layer_19_camera_body_and_feel.analyze: What camera system this looks like it was shot on

camera_system.category: DSLR / mirrorless / medium format digital / large format film / 35mm film / cinema camera / smartphone / action camera / drone / Polaroid-instant
camera_system.specific_model_emulation: real camera name — e.g., 'Canon EOS R5' / 'Sony A7R V' / 'Hasselblad X2D' / 'Phase One IQ4' / 'ARRI Alexa Mini LF' / 'RED V-Raptor' / 'Nikon F3 film body' / 'Leica M6' / 'Mamiya RZ67' / 'iPhone 15 Pro'
camera_system.sensor_size_feel: APS-C (crop, deeper DOF) / full frame (standard) / medium format (shallower DOF, smoother tonal transitions, 3D pop) / large format (extreme shallow DOF, ultimate detail) / cinema (varies)
camera_system.medium_format_look: if yes — the characteristic medium format 'look': smoother tonal gradations, slightly different perspective rendering, shallower DOF at same aperture vs full frame, richer color depth, that indescribable '3D pop'

technical_settings.iso: ISO value and its visual effect (ISO 100=clean / ISO 800=slight noise / ISO 3200=visible grain / ISO 12800=heavy grain)
technical_settings.shutter_speed: implied shutter speed — fast freezing (1/500+) / standard (1/125-1/250) / slow with possible motion blur (1/30 or slower)
technical_settings.white_balance: Kelvin value set on camera, affecting overall color temperature

output_fields.camera_movement_implied: even in a still image — does this feel like: locked tripod (perfectly stable, precise) / handheld (slight organic imperfection, raw, intimate) / steadicam (floating smooth, cinematic) / dolly (elegant tracking feel) / static with tension (deliberately frozen, controlled)

layer_20_aspect_ratio_and_format.analyze: Frame shape and its emotional impact

output_fields.ratio: 2.76:1 (ultra-wide epic) / 2.39:1 (anamorphic cinema standard) / 2:1 (Univisium) / 1.85:1 (US theatrical) / 16:9 (HD standard) / 3:2 (35mm standard photo) / 4:3 (classic, intimate) / 5:4 (medium format) / 1:1 (square) / 4:5 (Instagram portrait) / 9:16 (mobile vertical story)
output_fields.emotional_effect: how this shape affects the image feeling — wide = epic, expansive, cinematic / square = balanced, contained, social / vertical = intimate, towering, mobile-native / 4:3 = classic, confined, intimate

layer_21_lens_artifacts_detailed.analyze: Optical imperfections that add character and realism

output_fields.chromatic_aberration: none / very subtle purple-green fringing at high contrast edges / visible color separation (vintage lens) / heavy (old or cheap lens look)

lens_flare.type: warm soft glow / small circles chain / large streak / anamorphic horizontal blue streak / star pattern / veiling haze
lens_flare.source: what bright source causes it (sun, practical light, neon, window)
lens_flare.color: warm orange-gold / cool blue-white / multicolored / anamorphic blue-teal

output_fields.vignetting: none / very subtle natural light falloff / moderate darkened corners / heavy dark edges / optical vignette (gradual) / mechanical vignette (hard edge)
output_fields.barrel_distortion: none (rectilinear) / very slight (wide angle) / visible barrel (ultra-wide) / pincushion (telephoto) / mustache (complex)
output_fields.halation: none / subtle warm glow around bright highlights (film characteristic) / moderate bloom / heavy vintage halation
output_fields.coma: none / visible point-light stretching at frame edges (wide aperture wide angle)
output_fields.diffraction_stars: none / star pattern on point lights (very stopped down aperture, f/11+)
output_fields.optical_softness_pattern: sharp corner to corner (modern lens) / sharp center with soft edges (vintage or fast lens wide open) / overall slight softness (vintage character) / one side sharper than other (decentered element, very rare but realistic)

layer_22_key_light_surgical.analyze: Primary light source — the most important lighting element

source_type.natural: direct sun / golden hour sun (low warm) / blue hour (post-sunset cool) / overcast sky (giant softbox) / window light (size, type of window) / open shade / reflected sunlight
source_type.artificial: studio strobe / continuous LED / softbox (size) / beauty dish / ring light / umbrella / Fresnel / barn doors / grid / practical lamp / neon / candle / fire / screen glow / fluorescent tube / flash on-camera / flash off-camera

direction.horizontal: from camera-left / slightly camera-left / front (flat) / slightly camera-right / from camera-right — at what angle (15° / 30° / 45° / 60° / 90° full side / 120° / 150° / 180° back)
direction.vertical: from below (horror/dramatic) / at eye level / 30° above (loop) / 45° above (standard portrait) / 60° above (Rembrandt) / directly above (butterfly/paramount) / from very high behind

quality.hardness: very hard (sharp shadow edges, point source like bare bulb or direct small sun) / moderately hard / medium / moderately soft / very soft (gradual shadow transitions, large diffused source like overcast sky or large softbox)
quality.size_relative: small source relative to subject (harder) / medium / large source (softer) / enormous (sky-fill wrap)
quality.diffusion: no diffusion / slight / moderate (through curtain, softbox diffusion panel) / heavy (through heavy silk, multiple layers, frosted glass) / natural diffusion (clouds, fog, haze)

color_temperature.kelvin: specific number (1800K candle, 2700K warm tungsten, 3200K tungsten, 3500K warm LED, 4100K neutral, 5000K midday, 5600K daylight, 6500K cloudy, 7500K blue hour, 8000K+ deep shade blue)
color_temperature.color_cast: any specific color beyond temperature (green fluorescent tint, pink LED cast, etc.)

output_fields.falloff: how quickly light intensity decreases with distance — rapid (close source, inverse square dramatic) / gradual (distant source like sun, even) / even (large distant source)

layer_23_fill_light.analyze: What fills the shadows — critical for mood

output_fields.source: dedicated fill light / bounce board/reflector / ambient room bounce / open sky / secondary window / reflected surface (white wall, bright floor) / post-production fill / no fill (dramatic deep shadow)

PROMPT_COMPILATION_ENGINE.description: The engine that synthesizes 65 layers into one master prompt
compilation_order: 1. SUBJECT — complete description with pose, expression, physical details, hands safety
2. WARDROBE — clothing and styling with fabric behavior
3. CAMERA — shot size, angle, lens, DOF, bokeh, aspect ratio
4. COMPOSITION — framing, placement, lines, depth layers
5. LIGHTING — every light source, direction, quality, pattern, effects
6. COLOR — palette with HEX, grading style, saturation, contrast
7. ENVIRONMENT — location, background, foreground, surfaces, props
8. ATMOSPHERE — particles, weather, time of day, mood
9. SKIN + HAIR + FABRIC REALISM — anti-AI-failure details
10. TECHNICAL — camera body, film stock, grain, lens artifacts
11. STYLE REFERENCES — cinematographer, photographer, director, film, painter
12. PINTEREST AESTHETIC — style category and trending elements
14. AI SAFETY INJECTIONS — hands, eyes, body, physics
main_prompt_rules: Every word adds visual value — ZERO filler words
Technical terms paired with plain descriptions
Power words AI generators respond to placed strategically
Critical details repeated in different phrasing for redundancy
Emotional and atmospheric language woven throughout
Camera and lens specs stated naturally not as a spec sheet
Reads like a master cinematographer describing their vision to the crew
short_prompt_rules: Contains ONLY the visual DNA — the absolute essential elements
If you could only say 100 words to recreate this image, these are those words
Still includes key safety phrases (correct hands, realistic skin)
negative_prompt_rules: Include universal negatives: ugly, deformed, blurry, low quality, cartoon, painting, illustration, 3D render, watermark, text, logo, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, too many fingers, extra limbs, missing limbs, floating limbs, disconnected limbs, mutated, disfigured, poorly drawn face, mutation, worst quality, low quality, normal quality, lowres, cropped, artifacts
Include scene-specific negatives: anything that would contradict the intended image (e.g., for a warm golden hour image add 'cold blue tones, overcast, flat lighting')
Include style-specific negatives: prevent AI from defaulting to wrong style (e.g., for film look add 'digital plastic look, HDR, over-processed')
